title: Crüger to Müller, 4/14 April 1624
author: Peter Crüger
source: Peter Crüger's letter to Philipp Müller of 4/14 April 1624, written at Danzig, on why he still will not accept Kepler's theory of Mars. The original is in the Bibliothèque de l'Observatoire, Paris (B, 1, 9; 89, 9. K. 32). Printed in extracts in *Nova Kepleriana* 4, ed. Walther von Dyck and Max Caspar, Abhandlungen der Bayerischen Akademie der Wissenschaften, Math.-naturw. Abteilung 31, no. 1 (Munich, 1927), 108.
transcribed_from: the page images of the 1927 printing.
summary: Crüger admires Kepler's acumen but will not subscribe to his hypotheses for Mars, hoping God will show another way to the true theory.
